description: A small chibi pixel art head seen from the front, bald, with long pointed ears and big violet eyes. Paint only inside the white of the mask, across the eyes: put small half-moon reading glasses with thin gold frames sitting low on the nose, with clear lenses. The lenses are clear, so the eyes show through them. Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The rest of the face, the head and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
